headlines.title: Western Digital Shares Fall 3.6% as UBS Cuts Price Target Amid HDD Supply Concerns
Global chip selloff deepens as AI worries, China competition weigh
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of U.S. and European chipmakers fell Tuesday as a selloff in AI-exposed stocks deepened, pulling the broader technology sector lower amid concerns over the sustainability of AI investment and intensifying competition.

headlines.title: Is Western Digital (WDC) a Good or Bad Investment at Today’s Price?
headlines.summary: Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) closed at $397.28 on October 9. The stock has returned 13.4% during the last six months, compared to a 24.3% return for the Insider Monkey Billionaire Index and 15.1% for State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. Western Digital reports a net margin no hardware manufacturer has ever sustained.

headlines.title: Western Digital (WDC) Stock Looks Reasonable As AI Storage Contracts Expand
headlines.summary: Western Digital has turned into one of the most extreme long term winners in large cap tech, and that surge now raises a simple question for you as an investor. Does the current share price still line up with what the business is earning from selling high capacity drives into the AI data center boom, or has the stock run ahead of its earnings power?

headlines.title: Is Western Digital’s (WDC) AI-Fueled Outlook Reframing Its Role in Cloud Infrastructure Leadership?
headlines.summary: Western Digital recently reported strong fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 results, with revenue growth powered by demand for high-capacity storage and expanding cloud infrastructure needs. Management’s outlook for fiscal 2027, centered on AI-driven data growth and continued adoption of higher-capacity drives, highlights Western Digital’s role in underpinning large-scale cloud and AI workloads.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
